# Meridian

> Meridian is a 100% local, open-source work journal for developers, built by Meridiona. It remembers your day on-device and syncs approved worklogs to Jira, Linear, GitHub Projects, Azure DevOps, and Trello.

Meridian captures the apps and windows you work in, turns that into a private daily journal, and drafts worklog entries you review and approve before anything is ever posted to a project-management tool. Nothing leaves your Mac without your explicit approval. The app is MIT-licensed and fully auditable — free, no account required to try it.
